title: China
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office discusses various topics including China's military capabilities, office relocation plans, and internal conflicts. Michael debates China's military strength, claiming they have a missile capable of sinking US naval carriers, while Oscar counters with their own missile capabilities. The team also considers moving to a new office space, with Pam admitting to lying about the building's existence to gain leverage. Meanwhile, Dwight enforces building standards and questions Pam's motives, leading to tensions. The episode features casual office interactions, debates, and plans for future moves, with uncertainties about the exact outcomes and motivations.
